ana: Hit an opaque 413 in CI when batching embeddings of mixed dims (1024 + 256). Console only shows 413, no details.

ravi: Opaque 413s are bad. We should return structured preflight errors so SDKs can auto-split.

ana: repro: POST /v1/embeddings body: {"inputs": [vec1024, vec256]} -> 413.

tim: Proposal: X-Embed-Shape-Hint header for opt-in preflight (dims=1024,256;items=2;bytes=8900). If header absent, server runs a cheap shape-scan for big batches.

linda: Console needs a "preflight rejections" card with top error_code counts (dims_mismatch, oversize_bytes, too_many_items) and dims_signature buckets. Also action: "Enable auto-split for tenant".

ravi: Error schema (flat): error_code, machine_msg, client_hint, can_auto_split, split_plan (string like "0-0:1024;1-1:256"). No vector values returned.

ana: SDKs should look for can_auto_split and either retry automatically (opt-in) or present a fallback. We'll add helper to parse split_plan.

tim: Runtime note: shape checks are O(N) but cheap. Only run when items>1 or bytes>8kb. Avoid perf hit on small calls.

ops-bot: deploy note: embeds-prod canary applied 2024-06-20T11:05. Monitor preflight_mismatch metric.

ravi: Plan: RFC + minimal header + structured 4xx for mixed dims in first release. Console + SDK auto-split in second release.

ana: I'll open RFC and a small server PR returning 400 with the schema. Tim will patch SDKs. Linda will prototype console card.

ana: thanks :thumbsup:
